summary: The open-source web interface for Ansible is AWX; the supported Red Hat product is Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform.
questions: Is there a web UI or REST API for running Ansible?

answer_card.title: Web UI / REST API for Ansible
answer_card.answer_md: Use **AWX** (open source) for a web UI and REST API, or the supported **Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform**.
